ruleName: Limit of 14 Clubs; Sharing, Adding or Replacing Clubs During Round
title: Picking Up Another Player’s Club After Starting the Round
question: After starting a round, a player finds a wedge on the course that belongs to another player and, without realising, puts it in their own bag. They already have 14 clubs. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: There is no penalty, but the player must not use the club that doesn’t belong to them.
The player is penalised for having more than 14 clubs.
The player can use the extra club with no penalty.
The player must stop play until the club is returned.

explanation: If another player’s club is inadvertently put into a player’s bag after their round has started, it is not counted towards the 14-club limit, provided it is not used. There is no penalty as long as the player does not make a stroke with the extra club.
